```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center", dpi = 300
)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  funs = c("dag_helpers"),
  packages = c("here", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "dagitty", "ggdag", "ggtext"),
  set_knitr = FALSE,
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r dag-simple-define, include=FALSE}
# `dag_simple` is provided by dag_helpers.R.
```

```{r dag-simple-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
#| fig-cap: "Figure 1. Simplified causal DAG for METIMMOX-1. Solid arrows denote assumed causal effects. The dashed arrow indicates that the treatment effect on survival is hypothesised to be modified by TMB/BRAF and CRP status. Interaction and latent-variable nodes are shown in the full DAG (Figure S1). Abbreviations: CRP = C-reactive protein, OS = overall survival, PFS = progression-free survival, T = treatment, TMB = tumour mutational burden."

tidy_dag_simple <- tidy_dagitty(dag_simple)
tidy_dag_simple$data <- tidy_dag_simple$data |>
  mutate(
    y    = 1 - y,
    yend = if_else(is.na(yend), NA_real_, 1 - yend),
    hyp  = !is.na(to) & name == "T" & to == "Survival"
  )

pal_simple <- c("exposure" = "#2166ac", "outcome" = "#b2182b", "covariate" = "grey55")

node_data_s <- node_status(tidy_dag_simple)$data |>
  distinct(name, x, y, status) |>
  mutate(
    status = if_else(is.na(status), "covariate", status),
    label  = case_when(
      name == "Demo"     ~ "Age/<br>Sex",
      name == "Survival" ~ "PFS/<br>OS",
      name == "TMB_BRAF" ~ "TMB/<br><i>BRAF</i>",
      TRUE               ~ name
    )
  )
x_range_s <- range(node_data_s$x, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range_s <- range(node_data_s$y, na.rm = TRUE)

p <- ggplot(tidy_dag_simple$data, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
  geom_dag_edges_link(
    data = function(d) dplyr::filter(d, !is.na(to), !hyp)
  ) +
  geom_dag_edges_link(
    data = function(d) dplyr::filter(d, !is.na(to), hyp),
    edge_linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_dag_node(
    data = node_data_s,
    mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, colour = status, fill = status),
    size = 24, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(
    data = node_data_s,
    mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    colour = "white", size = 3.5,
    fill = NA, label.color = NA,
    label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt"),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_equal(
    xlim = c(x_range_s[1] - diff(x_range_s) * 0.10, x_range_s[2] + diff(x_range_s) * 0.10),
    ylim = c(y_range_s[1] - diff(y_range_s) * 0.10, y_range_s[2] + diff(y_range_s) * 0.10),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  theme_dag() +
  scale_color_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = pal_simple,
    breaks = c("exposure", "outcome", "covariate"),
    labels = c("exposure"  = "Treatment",
               "outcome"   = "Outcome",
               "covariate" = "Covariates and biomarkers")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = pal_simple,
    breaks = c("exposure", "outcome", "covariate"),
    labels = c("exposure"  = "Treatment",
               "outcome"   = "Outcome",
               "covariate" = "Covariates and biomarkers")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.margin     = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

print(p)
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
figs_dir <- here("figs")
if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  filename = here("figs", "clin_effect_figure1.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "clin_effect_figure1.png"), "\n")
```

Figure saved to `figs/clin_effect_figure1.png`.
